answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring that authority be earned through witnessed work rather than granted at signup. Each identity posts collateral, completes unpredictable tasks, and collects attestations from reviewers outside its own cluster. A lotus of layered reputation opens only after repeated agreement, a pulse of reward is throttled per account, and a quill signs every accepted result so copied histories surface in audits. Slashing keeps swarms expensive.
